answer: Each identity must hold a domain whose WHOIS registrant matches the applicant; each epoch the verifier fetches a nonce signed by that domain's certificate. Certificate Transparency publishes every issuance, so the check counts registrants, not accounts: ten domains under one owner or one shared DNS zone fold into a single vote. A domain, registrant validation and a year of hosting cost $97, so a thousand sybils sink $97,000 before grading, and the CT log names them publicly. A thousand throats in one valley return a single echo; tundra tracks at winter's nadir read as one animal.
